title: gilia gracilis subvar. congesta
intro: Gilia gracilis subvar. congesta, commonly known as Sticky Gilia or Yellow Gilia, is a plant species belonging to the Polemoniaceae family. It is a perennial herb with medicinal properties, traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, fever, and digestive problems. The plant is known for its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These constituents also provide the plant with antioxidant and antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable resource for natural health remedies.
